title: Zhehao's Tools for DNA Barcoding and Downstream Analyses
text: bold_get_query() — Construct validate BOLD API query strings across taxonomic, BIN, geographic, institution, recordset, ID criteria. bold_validate_query() — Validate query triplets BOLD query preprocessor. bold_get_token() — Request query token BOLD API. bold_download() — Download BOLD records tsv, dwc, json format. bold_read_data() — Parse downloaded BOLD text R data.frame. bold_write_data() — Write BOLD data objects disk. bold_retrieve() — End--end wrapper chunk, validate, download, parse, optionally save BOLD records. load_insd() — Load sequences metadata NCBI GenBank INSD XML files.

title: Zhehao's Tools for DNA Barcoding and Downstream Analyses
text: assemble_map_reference() — (Deprecated) Assemble Sanger .ab1 reads mapping reference sequence. mafft() — Run MAFFT multiple sequence alignment optionally view results browser. polish_alignment() — (Deprecated) Clean frame-shifting indels DNAbin alignment. check_polish() — Compare original polished DNAbin alignments via MAFFT. codon_summary() — Check reading frames stop codons protein-coding DNAbin alignments. trim_empty_columns() — Remove columns containing specified empty/gap/ambiguous characters DNAbin object. clean_label() — Format voucher accession labels FASTA alignments. gblocks() — Trim conserved alignment blocks using Gblocks. convert_nexus2fasta() — Convert NEXUS alignments FASTA format, optional outgroup removal label cleaning.

title: Run Automatic Barcoding Gap Discovery (ABGD) — abgd_execute
code: abgd_execute(   alignment,   exe,   output_folder = NULL,   a = T,   p = 0.001,   P = 0.1,   n = 20,   d = 3,   X = 1.5,   args = NULL,   overwrite = F )

title: Run Automatic Barcoding Gap Discovery (ABGD) — abgd_execute
text: alignment Character. Path input FASTA alignment file. exe Character. Path ABGD executable. output_folder Character NULL. Output directory path. Defaults file.path(dirname(alignment), "ABGD"). Logical. Whether pass -ABGD. Default TRUE. p Numeric. Minimum priori intraspecific divergence (Pmin). Default 0.001. P Numeric. Maximum priori intraspecific divergence (Pmax). Default 0.1. n Integer. Number steps [Pmin, Pmax]. Default 20. d Integer. Genetic distance option: 0 = Kimura-2P, 1 = Jukes-Cantor, 2 = Tamura-Nei, 3 = simple p-distance. Default 3. X Numeric. Minimum relative gap width / slope increase (X). Default 1.5. args Character NULL. Additional CLI arguments passed ABGD. Default NULL. overwrite Logical. Whether overwrite output_folder already contains files. Default FALSE.

title: Run Automatic Barcoding Gap Discovery (ABGD) — abgd_execute
text: Character path output_folder.
